title: Host-matrix harness: one scripted Chough cycle per agent host, judged from the files, with a stand-in-host self-test in hosted CI on macOS and Linux
description: Host-matrix harness: one scripted Chough cycle per agent host, judged from the files, with a stand-in-host self-test in hosted CI on macOS and Linux
acceptance_criteria: sh tools/host-matrix/selftest.sh prints HOST MATRIX SELFTEST PASSED on macOS and on Linux: the stand-in good run is PASS and each known-bad run is FAIL on the check that names it
Hosted CI runs the self-test as Host matrix self-test on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest
The harness never records a decision in a person name: every stand-in gate decision and native approval or review names SIMULATED-host-matrix-not-a-human

answers.constraints: The cli lessons in specs/cli/cli.3md: disposable repositories get a local Git identity (exercise identity, 2026-10-31); tasks.md lists gates and post-verification steps as plain text, not boxes; the delta is frozen at approval; new REQ IDs reach requirements.md only at change check, so the case is run after the scoped check; confirm an external agent can start before relying on it (cold-start tooling, 2026-10-31).
